messages:
incident-bot: PAGER — prod-embeddings: spike in p99 latency (us-west-2). Alerting oncall: @Aisha Khan @Sam Li. summary: p99 ~ 720ms, error-rate normal.
Aisha Khan: Ack. I'm primary until 12:00 UTC. Sam you're secondary?
Sam Li: Yep I'm secondary. I can take over if you need. Priya is in a meeting for the next 90m FYI.
Jules: Quick note — we just had a small rollout of a quantized variant on us-west-2 last hour. Could be related.
Aisha Khan: Good catch. I'll check rollout tags and traffic split. First quick checks: health endpoints, infra metrics, and KV cache hit rate.
Sam Li: Running health and pod list now — posting commands.
Sam Li: ```
# list embeddings pods
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=embeddings -o wide
# describe a suspect pod
kubectl -n prod describe pod embeddings-xyz
# hit readiness
curl -sS https://us-west-2.embeddings.internal/health | jq .
```
Priya M: If it's KV cache cold start, we have a warmup job: `jobs/kv-prefix-warmup` in k8s. That helped last time.
Aisha Khan: Checking KV cache hit rate in Grafana — currently drop from 98% to 42% for short-lived prefixes. That would explain p99.
Jules: I can revert traffic split off the quantized variant if needed. How long to fully revert? ~2 min to update route and drain.
Aisha Khan: Let's do targeted rollback if warmup doesn't reduce p99 in 5 minutes. Action plan now: 1) start warmup job, 2) monitor p99 for 5m, 3) rollback variant if no improvement.
ops-bot: Started job `kv-warmup-manual-4312` (k8s job id: kv-warmup-manual-4312). Notified on metrics channel.
Aisha Khan: Command to start warmup (for reference):
```
kubectl -n prod create job --from=cronjob/kv-prefix-warmup kv-warmup-manual-4312
```
Sam Li: Kicked off a focused trace on a slow request (tracing-id: trace-0a1b2c). point-of-interest is warm cache miss on shard-7.
Jules: Rolling back traffic split now to 100% stable variant. Doing canary removal.
Jules: ```
# update traffic split
redwoodctl routes update embeddings --set-variant=stable --region=us-west-2
```
Aisha Khan: Observing metrics: p99 decreased to ~210ms after warmup started and rollback in progress. Errors stayed low.
Priya M: Great — looks like KV cold start + small canary was the combo.
SRE-Escalate: Acknowledge. If p99 rises above 400ms again or error-rate increases >0.5% open bridge and tag me. I'll stand by.
Aisha Khan: On-call coverage: I'm primary until 12:00 UTC, Sam is secondary. Priya is backup after 12:00 and Jules will assist with rollbacks. Noted coverage gap from 11:45-12:00 where Priya is in a meeting; Sam will fill active pager.
Sam Li: I'll be ready to take over if Aisha needs to step away.
Aisha Khan: Recommended runbooks and quick links: 
- Embeddings KV cache warmup: https://confluence.redwood.com/runbooks/embeddings-kv-cache
- Rollback traffic split: https://confluence.redwood.com/runbooks/traffic-split-rollback
- Incident severity guide: https://confluence.redwood.com/incident/respond-guidelines
(Bookmark the kv-warmup job and redwoodctl snippets).
Aisha Khan: Current status: warmup job completed, p99 steady ~180ms for last 3m. I'll stay on watch for 15m then hand off. If anyone sees regression react here and escalate. :eyes: :thumbsup: 
ops-bot: Incident marked "mitigated" (monitoring). Please add a quick post-incident note to the runbook link above with steps taken.
Aisha Khan: Will add postmortem bullets and timeline. Handing off primary to Priya at 12:00 UTC — Sam will be active secondary.
Priya M: I'll pick up at 12:00 UTC. Thanks for the notes.
Sam Li: noted. closing loop from my side.
incident-bot: Note: Add severity label (S2) if customer-impact confirmed. Aisha please confirm later.
Aisha Khan: Confirming customer impact: minor latency increase for some embeddings requests, no errors reported to customers. Marking S2. Adding timeline to runbook now.
Jules: Thanks team — clean handoff.
